Little Hand Pies
Adapted from a synthetic cookbook

Crust
2 1/4 cups (280 grams) all-purpose flour
2 teaspoons sugar
3/4 teaspoon salt
1 cup (225 grams) cold butter, cubed
1 large egg
3 tablespoons cold water

1 extra egg (for the egg wash)

Apple Filling (fills 8 pies)
2 small apples, finely diced
2 tablespoons brown sugar
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
1 teaspoon lemon juice

Cherry Filling
1 cup pitted cherries, chopped
1 tablespoon cornstarch

Other fillings: 8 tablespoons fig jam, 8 tablespoons chocolate spread or 8 tablespoons of any thick preserve you like

To make apple filling: Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice.

To make cherry filling: Stir the cherries and cornstarch together in a small pot and cook until thick, about 3 minutes. Let cool.

Make the crust: Whisk the flour, sugar and salt, rub in the butter, then mix in the egg and water until a dough forms.

Split the dough in two, flatten each piece into a disc and chill for at least 1 hour.

Shape the pies: Roll each disc 1/8 inch thick and cut sixteen 4-inch circles. Spoon filling onto half of them, top with the rest and crimp with a fork.

Baker's tip: Freeze the scraps, then bake them later with cinnamon sugar for a cook's snack.

Bake the pies: Brush with the extra egg and bake at 375°F for 22 to 26 minutes, until golden.

Spelt Variation: Swap a third of the flour for spelt flour for a nuttier crust.

Mini Pies: Cut 2-inch circles instead and bake for about 15 minutes.

Do ahead: Unbaked pies freeze well for up to a month.
